claims.text: The resort sits on a private hill overlooking Lamai Bay, enveloped by jungle greenery.

findings.quote: Enveloped by lush jungle greenery on a private hill overlooking Lamai Bay, our property serves as a highly private retreat
findings.note: The page states the private hill, the view over Lamai Bay and the jungle greenery.

claims.text: A dedicated Villa Host is provided for all villa types.

findings.quote: Yes, a dedicated Villa Host is provided for all villa types at Banyan Tree Samui
findings.note: The FAQ confirms a Villa Host for all villa types.

claims.text: The Horizon Hillcrest Pool Villa has an extensive outdoor lounge, a sky-suspended swimming pool and open-villa living quarters.

findings.quote: an extensive outdoor lounge, sky-suspended swimming pool and open-villa living quarters filled with warm, fresh air
findings.note: All three features are listed on the villa page.

claims.text: The Royal Banyan Ocean Pool Villa has an infinity pool with an adjacent jet pool.

findings.quote: Refresh in the cool waters of your infinity pool or soak in the warmth of the adjacent jet pool.
findings.note: The page describes an infinity pool with an adjacent jet pool.

claims.text: The Sanctuary Residence has a living area that links two one-bedroom villas.

findings.quote: an elegantly-appointed living area interlinking two one-bedroom villas
findings.note: The page says the living area links two one-bedroom villas.

claims.text: The Rainforest combines European spa and hydrothermal therapy with Asian wellness in one hydrotherapy experience.

findings.quote: Combining the best of European spa and hydrothermal therapy with the essence of Asian wellness, The Rainforest is a complete hydrotherapy experience
findings.note: The facilities page matches the claim.

claims.text: Complimentary beach activities include kayaking, stand-up paddle boarding, sailing and snorkelling in the house reef steps from the shoreline.

findings.quote: with our complimentary activities on offer including kayaking, stand-up paddle boarding, sailing or snorkeling in the house reef located just steps away from the shoreline.
findings.note: All listed activities are named as complimentary.

claims.text: The Kids' Club is for children ages four to 12, with activities including arts and crafts and games.

findings.quote: Our Kids' Club is available for children ages four to 12 and features a variety of activities for entertainment including arts and crafts as well as games.
findings.note: The age range and the activities both match.

claims.text: Guests can learn muay thai, or Thai kickboxing, in indoor or outdoor classes.

findings.quote: Learn the fighting techniques and cultural practices of 'muay thai', or Thai kickboxing, with our indoor or outdoor classes.
findings.note: Indoor and outdoor muay thai classes are confirmed.

claims.text: An on-site Sustainability Manager with a marine biology background works with Thailand's Department of Marine and Coastal Resources to protect the local coral reef.

findings.quote: Banyan Tree Samui features an on-site Sustainability Manager with a background in marine biology who collaborates closely with Thailand's Department of Marine and Coastal Resources to monitor and protect the local coral reef.
findings.note: Every element of the claim is stated.

claims.text: Saffron serves authentic Thai cuisine with performances of Menora, a traditional dance of southern Thailand.

findings.quote: Delight in an evening at Saffron for authentic Thai cuisine and performances of 'Menora', a traditional dance of southern Thailand.
findings.note: Saffron, the Thai cuisine and the Menora dance performances all match.

claims.text: Destination Dining is set at the main pool with the bay behind it, or at Infinity Point, which looks over the resort.

findings.quote: at our main pool backdropped by coconut trees and the stunning bay or at the Infinity Point where you get a picturesque view of our resort

claims.text: Banyan Tree Samui overlooks the Gulf of Thailand and sits amid jungle on a private bay in Lamai.

findings.quote: Overlooking the azure waters of the Gulf of Thailand, Banyan Tree Samui is nestled amid the lush jungle of a private bay in Lamai.
findings.note: The page matches the claim exactly.

claims.text: Every villa has a private pool, in a range of configurations, sizes and views.

findings.quote: Each villa features private pools and comes in a range of configurations, sizes, and views.
findings.note: The FAQ confirms each villa has a private pool.

claims.text: The Rainforest is a hydrotherapy circuit of heat and cool stages, from sauna to vitality pool.

findings.quote: Embark on a hydrotherapy circuit of heat and cool stages - from sauna to vitality pool.
findings.note: The spa page matches the claim.

claims.text: The resort has a house reef in its bay, reached from its private beach.

findings.quote: Our resort has a house reef in our bay, which is accessible from our private beach.
findings.note: The house reef and its access from the private beach are confirmed.

claims.text: Guests can head out on the resort's private speedboat, Sense of the Sea.

findings.quote: Create your own perfect day in paradise travelling onboard our private speedboat, Sense of the Sea.
findings.note: The private speedboat Sense of the Sea is confirmed.

claims.text: The resort is about 5 km from the main area of Lamai and about 15 km from the main area of Chaweng.

findings.quote: We are located approximately 5 km away from the main area of Lamai and approximately 15 km away from the main area of Chaweng.

claims.text: The resort says January through October typically bring clear skies, sunny weather and calm seas.

findings.quote: The best time to visit Banyan Tree Samui is from January through October, as these months typically feature clear skies, sunny weather, and calm seas

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the secluded hillside location means navigating steep terrain.
